messages.content:
Risk: AI deception
Description: The AI system may misrepresent its own capabilities or limitations, potentially leading to misplaced trust or inappropriate
Concern: None
Policy: Medical Professional Impersonation

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/AgentsAndPeople/Agents/AutomatedSystem: automated system — system that reduces or eliminates the need for human involvement in order to complete a task [found by 5/7 queries]
  Siblings: party, software agent, Agent
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000246: obsolete: behavior AE — a behavioral AE that results in uncharacteristic behaviors [found by 4/7 queries]
  Siblings: obsolete: reflexes decreased AE, thrombocythemia AE - OBSOLETE (due to duplication), obsolete: medical device adverse event
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 6/7 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001017: Agent — A Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability. [found by 6/7 queries]
  Siblings: portion of pathological body substance, Target, physical sign
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Agent: agent — something autonomous that can adapt to and interact with its environment [found by 6/7 queries]
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001379: Agent Capability — A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act. [from restriction: BFO_0000196 on ont00001017]
  Siblings: Strength, Affordance, plan
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_0000040: material entity — An independent continuant that is spatially extended whose identity is independent of that of other entities and can be maintained through time. [from equivalence]
  Siblings: hydrogensulfite, ornithinium(1+), posterior sector of right lobe of liver

axes.rationale: The risk involves an AI system (a software agent) performing deceptive actions. This class identifies the type of entity performing the deception.
The core of the risk is the misrepresentation of 'capabilities or limitations'. This axis allows for variation in what specific capabilities the AI is pretending to have or lacks.
